title: Ruuh bu woyof ci yonent yi
intro: Baat buy woo njub mingi dégg ci aaya yi ci Al Quran bu tedd bi. Ruuh bu barkeel boobu, ñu jox ko yonent yi ak mbindu Yàlla ci jamono ji doomi Israyil soxla woon lool njiit. Nit ki dafa wax ak seen askan, di leen ñaax ñu fàttaliku seen Boroom. Ci muñ ak njub, ñu nekk làmp-leer bu jaar-jaaram di leeralal xëti Mbind mu sell mi. Ndax mën nga ràññee nit ku am solo kii ñu sargal turam ci Al Quran ak ci Injiil?
clues: Dañu ma sargal ak nekk yonent ak téere asamaan ci jamonoy soxlay sama askan.
Sama yaay jural nama ci anam wu yéeme, ci ndigalu Yàlla rekk.
Ma wax ak sama askan, ne leen: 'Yéen doomi Israyil! Man maay yónnent Yàlla ci yéen, di dëggal li ma jiitu”.
Maa ngi ñëw ak firnde yu leer yu jóge ci sa Boroom, di yónnee xebaar bu neex ci yonent bu tuddu Ahmad.
Sama yaay jigéen ju jub la woon, wékkoon ma ci jaamu Yàlla li ko dale sama ndaw.
Allah moo ma jàngal Al Quran, defal ma yërmaande ak def sama wareef ci sama yaay, te duma réy wala déggal sama yaay.

arabic: وَإِذْ قَالَ عِيسَى ٱبْنُ مَرْيَمَ يَـٰبَنِىٓ إِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ إِنِّى رَسُولُ ٱللَّهِ إِلَيْكُم مُّصَدِّقًۭا لِّمَا بَيْنَ يَدَىَّ مِنَ ٱلتَّوْرَىٰةِ وَمُبَشِّرًۢا بِرَسُولٍۢ يَأْتِى مِنۢ بَعْدِى ٱسْمُهُۥٓ أَحْمَدُ ۖ فَلَمَّا جَآءَهُم بِٱلْبَيِّنَـٰتِ قَالُوا۟ هَـٰذَا سِحْرٌۭ مُّبِينٌۭ
verse: And [mention] when Jesus, the son of Mary, said, "O Children of Israel, indeed I am the messenger of Allāh to you confirming what came before me of the Torah and bringing good tidings of a messenger to come after me, whose name is Aḥmad." But when he came to them with clear evidences, they said, "This is obvious magic." (61:6)
